title: Compacter fast-factor Mirror adapter views
hypothesis: On held-out adapter regression tasks generated from a shared Kronecker slow basis, per-task compact rotation coordinates over shared rank-one fast factors reach independent-adapter quality at lower payload than native Compacter and beat a byte-matched scalar-coefficient control.
physical_object: shared linear map with Compacter-style Kronecker slow basis
mirror_coordinate: one 2D Givens angle per task applied to paired shared rank-one fast-factor channels
logical_multiplicity: six task-specific adapter functions from shared slow and fast factors
controls: native Compacter with task-specific rank-one fast factors
shared fast-factor bank plus scalar task coefficients

task.teacher: shared Kronecker slow atoms combined with task-local rank-one fast factors; no teacher values copied into student initialization

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across methods and development worlds

fresh.access_condition: development Mirror MSE <= 1.10x independent upper reference and actual payload <= native Compacter payload

storage.serialization: torch.save complete CPU state_dict plus JSON config

gates.promising: 3/3 fresh worlds: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent upper reference; bytes <= native Compacter and <=0.80x independent; and Mirror MSE at least 10% below scalar-control at equal/lower bytes.
gates.fail: development gate misses or two fresh worlds show Mirror >1.25x independent error, or scalar control matches within 10% at equal/lower bytes.
gates.not_established: invalid data split, serialization mismatch, or incomplete runs

boundaries: fixed 500-update screen is not a capacity claim
no language-model or GPU inference claim

cross_worker_adjudication.decision: selectively import experiment directory and evidence rows; do not merge branch-wide deletions from stale baseline
cross_worker_adjudication.fresh_worlds: sealed by preregistered development access gate
